pr_title: Feature: Added support for custom key bindings
pr_body:
## Summary

- [x] Added an empty page named Actions
- [x] Added PointerOver visual state
- [x] Added support to edit remapping with custom TextBox editor
- [x] Added support to save remapped keyboard to the json
- [x] Added support to remove a mapping including default ones
- [x] Added support to cancel editing
- [x] Added support to show a teaching tip says it's already taken
- [x] Added support to reset all mappings to default
- [x] Added automation test for Actions page
- [x] Localize
- [x] Hide actions that use mouse buttons (this is only temporary)
- [x] Fix issue where alt keys can switch to other pages
    ⇒ Temporarily we removed access keys of the navigation view in Settings dialog. Once we go towards Settings tabs we can add back safely without malfunctioning

## PR Checklist

- [x] Were these changes approved in an issue or discussion with the project maintainers? In order to prevent extra work, feature requests and changes to the codebase must be approved before the pull request will be reviewed. This prevents extra work for the contributors and maintainers.

- [ ] Did you check for accessibility? You can use Accessibility Insights for this.
- [ ] Did you remove any strings from the en-us resource file?
   - [ ] Did you search the solution to see if the string is still being used? 
- [x] Did you implement any design changes to an existing feature?
   - [x] Was this change approved?
- [x] Are there any other steps that were used to validate these changes?
   1. Go to Actions page in Settings dialog
   2. Edit, reset, save a mapping

issue_context.title: Feature: Add support for key remapping
issue_context.body:
### Solution/Idea

As Files gets more advanced and the number of shortcuts keeps growing, it'll be useful to allow keyboard remapping to allow users to configure shortcuts to work the way they like it.

![image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/39923744/f9e173ce-c229-4ee3-b08c-60f695f186c6)


### Requirement

This proposal will add a settings page called "Actions"
This page will contain a list of actions
This proposal will allow configuring the shortcut or gesture to configure each action
This proposal will allow users to reset all actions to the default

### Files Version

v2.3

### Windows Version

_No response_
comments:
Here is a custom KeyPicker that I could integrate into Files. What do you think?

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46631671/179416381-91b554f2-69b4-4a67-90ec-a1b8e063ede1.mp4

Remapping actions is already supported if you manually edit the settings file
1. Open Settings > Advanced > Edit settings file
2. Right click the system tray icon for Files and click "Quit"
3. Go back to the settings file and find the section for "Actions"
4. The list of available actions can be found [here](https://github.com/files-community/Files/blob/main/docs/rich-commands.md)

Here is an example remapping the copy action to `ctrl` + `j`
```json
"Actions": {
    "CopyItem": "ctrl+j"
 },
```

![Image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/62196528/9a0c6f9d-c0a6-4af2-b032-93c36f3b422b)

A page would be great? Working on it.
@0x5bfa nice! I would suggest calling the page "Actions" as it's supposed to be more than just keyboard shortcuts.
The requirements listed above are still accurate but I don't have any specific design in mind for the UI.
A big shoutout to @0x5bfa for completing this large task 🎉

> This proposal will allow configuring the shortcut or gesture to configure each action

Custom gestures are out of scope for now, but we'll continue exploring to see if there is a path forward for them.

review_comments: This can be not null, or not? The implementation seems safe

The default json string is like `Actions: null` but previously once initialize and empty it, it will be `Actions: {}`. Making it nullable makes sense in this case, I assume. There's a code line ActionsViewModel that makes it null to restore all default (if not nullable, a warning will persists)
It was empty string when no context given, like in this page.

Looks not nice but better than nothing to show. It'd be better if we add simple title for this situation too as you suggested for Install commands.
Don't we want `,` to be a valid separator?
',' is also valid hotkey. Using ',' as separator causes to misinterpret. Space or Tab is only valid for this situation because  we store them as 'Space' or 'Tab' not actual  characters
I don't think it is necessary to convert private readonly fields to properties.
As a practice I use private properties for DI instances.

A private property internally generates a private readonly field and a getter method, but there is no need to provide a getter method if it is private. It may be better to set a policy in the coding style guidelines.
In my PR in the Website repo, which has been suspended for a long time, written.

In your opinion what's the best practice? I'd like them to be PascalCase.
I think we can open a ticket for this.
I don't have a preference about naming conventions, but ideally I think all properties that can be replaced with private readonly fields should be replaced.
